name: photo

params.zoom: end scale of the Ken Burns move, default 1.12
params.pan: left | right | none, default alternates by scene id
params.layout: full (default) | split_text (picture on one half, title on the other) | split2 (two pictures left / right; top / bottom in 9:16) | stack (two pictures top / bottom) | crop (full frame shrinks to a 1:1 square on one side, title in the rest). split2 / stack without image2 fall back to split_text; logos ignore it
params.side: left | right (top | bottom in 9:16): where the main picture sits in split_text / split2 / crop, default left (top)
params.image2: second picture for split2 / stack, path relative to the project root (e.g. assets/processed/A012.png)
params.crop_at: crop: seconds before the shrink starts, default 0.8 (at most 40% of the scene)
params.dim: true or 0-1: darken the picture (default 0.5) only while the title is on screen, then restore it
params.text_until: seconds: the title leaves at this time (with dim: default 65% of the scene, so the picture comes back bright)

description: Still image with a Ken Burns pan/zoom, blurred backdrop when the aspect does not fit, lower-third text; optional in-scene compositions (split / stack / 1:1 crop) and a dim while the title shows
